_: Standard merge-first answers (driver/standard-answer.sh). Read only while release.mergeFirst is on; release.standardAnswers in harness.json replaces this file, false turns it off. Patterns are jq regexes, case-insensitive, over the step's question and its park reason. park is read first and always wins; then the classes in order, first match taken.

a.name: base red: wait
a.answer: Wait. A red the base branch has too is the base's to fix, never this change's: the ticket waits for the base (base-red), and nothing of the base is fixed here.

b.name: follow-up of an open PR: wait for the parent
b.answer: Wait. A follow-up of a pull request that has not merged waits for that pull request: the ticket is blocked on the parent and goes back to ready when it merges. Nothing is folded into the parent.

e.name: signed off: ship
e.answer: Ship as signed off. Under merge first nothing is re-captured or re-signed before the merge; the owner looks on UAT.

c.name: Minor or Major finding: defer
c.answer: Defer it as fix-after-merge and ship. Until the release only a Critical blocks; a Major or Minor finding is its own follow-up ticket (a Minor waits until after launch).

d.name: critic, evidence or pictures: ignore
d.answer: Ignore it and ship. Until the release the design critic, the evidence, the screenshots and the picture hold nothing; the owner looks on UAT.
